title: Let the Guru's goad train the wild mind
summary: The Guru's Shabad trains the wild mind and guards the inner treasure. Let the Shabad's goad interrupt clever impulse.
takeaway: Let the Shabad's goad interrupt clever impulse.
lifeApplication: When impulse reaches for the lead, stop before cleverness acts and take the Guru's discipline as the controlling stick.
